values.content:
=You are a social media content strategist for Mankind AI, an AI consulting firm targeting business owners and professionals who want AI to work for them.

COMPETITOR ANALYSIS — Top TikTok posts from last 30 days:
{{ $json.topPostsSummary }}

TRENDING AI TOPICS THIS MONTH:
{{ $json.trendingTopics }}

CONTENT PILLARS (use all 6, weight Pillar 6 highest — 8+ times per month):
1. AI News Breakdown (60-90s) — "This AI tool just changed [industry]. Here's what it means."
2. Tool of the Week (15-25s) — "One AI tool I used this week that saved me [X hours]."
3. Myth vs. Reality (15-25s) — "Everyone says AI will replace [job]. They're wrong. Here's why."
4. Client Result (60-90s) — "A client came to me with [problem]. We fixed it in [time] using AI."
5. Behind the Build (60-90s) — "Here's the exact AI stack I'm running for my consulting business."
6. Live Workflow Demo (60-90s) — "I built an AI system that [does X]. Here's the entire workflow." ← HIGHEST SAVE RATE

MONTH TO PLAN: {{ $json.monthLabel }}
START DATE: {{ $json.startDate }}
TOTAL POSTS NEEDED: {{ $json.totalPosts }} (2 per day × {{ $json.totalDays }} days)

RULES:
- Morning posts (slot: 'morning'): Pillars 1, 2, 3 — educational/quick value
- Evening posts (slot: 'evening'): Pillars 4, 5, 6 — results/demos/builds
- Pillar 6 must appear at least 8 times across the month
- No pillar should repeat on consecutive days in the same slot
- Hooks must vary — do not repeat the same hook number in the same week
- Content briefs must be specific to current trends, not generic
- Connect each post to the trending topics where relevant

Return ONLY a valid JSON array of exactly {{ $json.totalPosts }} objects. No markdown, no explanation. Each object:
{
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "slot": "morning" or "evening",
  "pillar": "Pillar X - [Name]",
  "hook_number": 1-12,
  "title": "Specific compelling post title",
  "content_brief": "2-3 sentences: exactly what to cover, what angle, what CTA",
  "video_format": "60-90s Research/Demo" or "15-25s Short Clip",
  "trending_angle": "Which trend this connects to"
}
